mapper.sql: id, event_id, image_id, event_type, topic, tag, message_key, payload, broker_message_id, sent_time, create_time, schema_version, status, retry_count, max_retries, next_retry_time, version_id, last_error, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM file_mq_outbox WHERE status in ('NEW', 'RETRY_WAIT') and next_retry_time <= current_timestamp order by next_retry_time, id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update file_mq_outbox set status = 'SENDING', version_id = #{expectedVersionId} + 1, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and version_id = #{expectedVersionId} and next_retry_time <= current_timestamp and status in ('NEW', 'RETRY_WAIT')

update file_mq_outbox set status = 'SENT', broker_message_id = #{brokerMessageId}, last_error = null, sent_time = current_timestamp, update_time = current_timestamp, version_id = #{expectedVersionId} + 1 where id = #{id} and version_id = #{expectedVersionId} and status = 'SENDING'

update file_mq_outbox set status = 'RETRY_WAIT', next_retry_time = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{nextRetryTime}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, version_id = #{expectedVersionId} + 1, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and version_id = #{expectedVersionId} and status = 'SENDING' and retry_count < max_retries

update file_mq_outbox set status = 'DEAD', last_error = #{lastError}, version_id = #{expectedVersionId} + 1, update_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and version_id = #{expectedVersionId} and status = 'SENDING' and retry_count >= max_retries
mapper.select: select from file_mq_outbox where status = 'SENDING' and update_time < TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, -#{timeoutSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) order by update_time, id limit #{limit}
